# Evaluation Rubric: Agile Story Writer

Use this rubric to evaluate the quality of the generated agile story.

| Criteria | 1 - Poor | 3 - Good | 5 - Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Title** | Vague (e.g., "Fix bug") | Follows `[Action] [What] [System]` | Specific, uses approved verb, identifies outcome |
| **Persona** | Generic ("a user") | Specific role from `personas.md` | Well-defined role with clear context |
| **User Story** | Missing or weak outcome | Clear `As a/I want/So that` | Outcome is measurable and business-aligned |
| **ACs** | Not GIVEN/WHEN/THEN | GIVEN/WHEN/THEN used, but some subjective | All ACs objective, testable, and high quality |
| **Scope Boundaries** | Missing Scope OUT | Scope IN/OUT present | Clear boundaries that prevent scope creep |
| **Estimates** | No points or rationale | Points provided with brief rationale | Fibonacci used with clear complexity justification |
| **NFRs** | Missing or generic | Present for Perf/Sec/Obs | Specific, measurable targets (e.g., p95 < 200ms) |
